name: Tess Aldin
appearance: Lean and hard-jawed, scalp shaved to blue stubble, knuckles wrapped in grey linen; wrestles barefoot.
backstory: Tess pinned Big Hesta to win the 1482 Open at 25, then lost five finals to her by Out. In 1491 she reached the final and lost to Chadickith, crying 'Ash' as the third finger came down.

relationships.name: Chadickith
relationships.how: the first to pin her since she was a girl
